title: Saved a ChatGPT Temporary Chat? This Changes the Rules #Shorts
description: A visual, original fictional learning example from FlowMinute Lab. Temporary Chat stays out of your ChatGPT history while it remains temporary. But there is a way to save it. Learn the safe verification step using the official product guidance below. Original diagrams and synthetic English narration; not a real account or software screen capture. Official source: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8914046-temporary-chat-in-chatgpt #FlowMinuteLab #TechTips

scenes.title: TEMP CHAT, THEN SAVE
scenes.narration: Temporary Chat stays out of your ChatGPT history while it remains temporary. But there is a way to save it.

scenes.title: AFTER YOU SAVE
scenes.narration: OpenAI explains that saving a temporary chat converts it into a regular chat with different history and data rules.

scenes.title: TRAINING CONTROL
scenes.narration: Once saved, your model-improvement setting and applicable workspace policies determine whether it can be used for training.

scenes.title: MEMORY DIFFERENCE
scenes.narration: Temporary chats do not create memories. After saving, normal personalization rules can apply to that conversation.

scenes.title: THE SAFE HABIT
scenes.narration: Before saving, review any sensitive details and the resulting retention rules. Temporary does not mean permanently impossible to store.
